title: Review round 2: kith-store
description: Review round 2 findings for kith-store. P1 bugs: mark_failed skips state counter advance (Message/changes blind to failed delivery), get_or_create not atomic. P2: unconditional state advance on no-ops in get_or_create/set_blocked/update_last_message_at, shift overflow in record_failure, insert counter-before-INSERT not transactional.
